content.comment_body: Hello everyone, This is my first post on the forum. My question is: Is it possible to mount [product_name] with both EIB/KNX and AS-Interface at the same time? Thank you all.

Hello [user_name], When checking the manual at [url], specifically Chapter 2.1.1, it mentions that the EIB/KNX communication module should be the last module on the right side of [product_name]. Similarly, the AS-Interface module is recommended to be placed as the last module on the right side as well. I hope this information is helpful. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to know if it's possible to simultaneously use EIB/KNX and AS-Interface modules with [product_name]. Responses indicate that both modules are recommended to be installed as the rightmost module, raising uncertainty about using them together due to possible installation or functional conflicts.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to mount and operate [product_name] with both EIB/KNX and AS-Interface communication modules concurrently, without running into technical or physical limitations.
